notify.uncopiedTitle: {address} is not keeping copies of what you send
notify.uncopiedBody: Your messages are going out, but the mail server would not file a copy in Sent, so they are not in your own record of them.
notify.unsentBody: {detail} It is in Drafts, where you can change it and try again.
notify.reconnectBody: Its authorization was refused or withdrawn, so Polaris paused checking it. Reconnect it in Mail to start again.
notify.passwordBody: If you changed it recently, update it in Mail. Polaris paused checking this mailbox so the server does not lock it for repeated failed sign-ins.

search.title: Search: {query}
search.emptyBody: Polaris searches the mail it has already fetched, which is the newest few hundred messages of each folder. Anything older is still on the mail server.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.emptyBody: Everything that has arrived is dealt with.

starred.title: Starred
starred.emptyBody: Star a conversation to keep it here, across every mailbox.

important.title: Important
important.emptyBody: Mark a message important to keep it here, across every mailbox.

snoozed.title: Snoozed
snoozed.emptyBody: A conversation you snooze drops out of the inbox until the hour you chose.

sent.title: Sent
sent.emptyBody: Messages you send appear here, across every mailbox.

archive.title: Archive
archive.emptyBody: Archiving takes a conversation out of the inbox without deleting it.

junk.title: Spam
junk.emptyBody: What your mail server marks as spam ends up here.

trash.title: Trash
trash.emptyBody: Deleted conversations wait here until the mail server clears them out.

delivery.accepted: Your outgoing server accepted it at {time}, and nothing has come back since. That is as much as Polaris can know about a message once it is handed over.
delivery.copyFailed: The mail server would not keep a copy of it in Sent.
delivery.noSent: This mailbox has no Sent folder, so no copy was kept.

selftest.sending: Sending a message from this mailbox to itself.
selftest.refused: The outgoing server would not take the message.
selftest.arrived: {copy, select, failed {No copy could be filed in Sent. } none {This mailbox has no Sent folder, so no copy was kept. } other {}}The message was sent and came back into this mailbox, so sending and receiving both work.
selftest.accepted: {copy, select, failed {No copy could be filed in Sent. } none {This mailbox has no Sent folder, so no copy was kept. } other {}}Your outgoing server accepted the message. It has not arrived back here yet, which for a mailbox at another provider can take a few minutes.

body.readerTheme: Show this in the Polaris theme
body.ownPage: Show this on its own white page
body.empty: This message has nothing in it.
body.trackers: Trackers from {named} were served through Polaris, so they learned nothing about you.

address.copyRefused: This browser would not let Polaris copy that.

onboarding.title: Read your mail here
onboarding.lead: Connect the address you already use. Polaris works out the rest from it, so for most services there is nothing else to fill in.

together.title: Every mailbox in one place
together.body: Connect as many as you like. One inbox holds all of them, and each keeps its own colour so you always know which is which.

private.title: Nothing loads until you say so
private.body: Polaris fetches every picture for you, so a sender learns that a server asked and nothing about you - not your address, not your browser, not when you opened it.

local.title: It stays on your Polaris
local.body: Your mail is read straight from your own mail server. Nothing about it is sent anywhere else.

onboarding.how: Gmail and Outlook connect by authorizing the account. Anything else takes the password for that mailbox.

shell.moved: {count, plural, one {Moved to {folder}.} other {# moved to {folder}.}}

folderRole.title: Which folder is your {label}?
folderRole.body: {mailbox} does not have a folder Polaris recognises as its {label}. Point at the one you already use and it will remember, on this mailbox and through every later check.
folderRole.noOthers: This mailbox has no other folders to choose from.
folderRole.make: Make one on the mail server
folderRole.makeHint: Making one adds a folder to your mail server, which you will see in every other mail client you use.

unsubscribe.label: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.question: Unsubscribe from {sender}?
unsubscribe.finishBody: Their server did not accept the request Polaris sent. The page below is the same address, opened as you rather than as this server.
unsubscribe.direct: Polaris will tell their server directly. Nothing is opened, and they learn nothing about you that this message did not already carry.
unsubscribe.fromBody: Polaris will send a message from this mailbox to an address it found inside the mail, not in a header {sender} published. If the mail was not really from them, sending it tells whoever wrote it that this address is read.
unsubscribe.byMail: Polaris will send them a message from this mailbox asking to be taken off. Nothing else is shared with them.
